metadata.name: pepperstone_razor_major_fx_example
metadata.purpose: Versioned research-only example for offline estimated net returns.
metadata.conversion_rule: For the listed major FX examples, 1 pip = 10 MT5 points.
metadata.fallback_policy: Average spread values are converted to fallback_spread_points; minimum spread values are not used as fallbacks.
metadata.robust_research_note: Prefer p75, p90, or p95 spread calibration from MT5 exports or the local DB before relying on broker-aware net results.
metadata.commission_note: commission_bps_round_trip is a conservative placeholder assumption, not an exact Pepperstone account fact; verify and replace it from the user's account conditions before use.
metadata.slippage_note: slippage_bps_round_trip is a research assumption, not a broker fact.
metadata.xauusd_note: XAUUSD is intentionally omitted because the provided Pepperstone table did not include XAUUSD spread values.
